hours.text: We're open Monday to Saturday, 7 in the morning to 9 at night, with a short lunch break from 2 to 2:30. We're closed on Sundays.

pricing_policy.text: Prices depend on the tooth and the treatment, so the doctor confirms the exact cost after a quick look, but I can give you a rough range.

insurance_policy.text: We don't do cashless insurance, but we give you itemised bills and reports so you can claim it back from your insurer.

escalation.text: The doctor can go through that with you at your visit.

facts.text: A consultation or check-up is 400 rupees, and it's adjusted against any treatment you start that day.
A cleaning is usually between 1,000 and 1,500 rupees.
A filling is usually 1,000 to 2,500 rupees, depending on the size and the material.
A root canal is usually 5,000 to 8,000 rupees per tooth, and a crown afterwards is extra, from about 4,000.
A simple extraction is about 800 to 1,500 rupees; a wisdom tooth can be 3,000 to 6,000.
Braces usually come to 35,000 to 70,000 rupees for the full treatment, and there's a no-cost EMI option.
Invisalign is usually between one and a half and three lakh rupees, depending on how much correction is needed.
A children's visit is usually 400 to 600 rupees.
We do whitening too, usually 6,000 to 12,000 rupees; the doctor sees you briefly first to check it suits your teeth.
We do implants as well, usually 25,000 to 45,000 rupees per tooth; it starts with a consultation.
You can pay by UPI, card or cash.
For braces and Invisalign there's a no-cost EMI option over six to twelve months.
Just bring any old X-rays or prescriptions, and a list of any medicines you take.

facts.topic: how long the first visit takes
facts.text: A first visit takes about 30 to 45 minutes, including the check-up and an X-ray if it's needed.
We see children of all ages; a parent just needs to come along for anyone under 18.

facts.topic: how many visits a root canal takes
facts.text: A root canal usually takes two or three visits of about an hour each.
All our branches have digital X-rays, so you get it done right there.
Treatments are done with local anaesthetic, so it's usually very comfortable, and the doctor checks in with you throughout.
All instruments are sterilised after every patient, and we use disposables wherever we can.
There's no fee to cancel or move an appointment, just let us know.
If you're in a lot of pain or have swelling, we'll fit you in the same day.
Walk-ins are welcome, but booking ahead means you won't have to wait.
Our staff speak English, Kannada and Hindi.

Pearl Dental has four branches in Bengaluru, at Nagarbhavi, Indiranagar, Jayanagar and Whitefield, with eight doctors between them. We do check-ups, cleanings, fillings, root canals, extractions, braces, Invisalign and children's dentistry.
I can tell you about our clinic, the services we offer, our doctors, prices and timings, and book, change or cancel appointments.
